game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk, a cracked obelisk: the rune scholar must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Cracked Obelisk.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk: a cracked obelisk
core_gameplay_loop: In Cracked Obelisk, repeat each round: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Cracked Obelisk. Each round, crypt crawlers strike the sealed archway, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the capacity value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sealed archway from crypt crawlers in Cracked Obelisk: keep the capacity meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: capacity drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Length Limit
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how capacity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crypt crawlers in Cracked Obelisk.
